Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the note and the quote — appreciate the clear breakdown. A couple items from procurement side: 

- Our preferred flow is a PO routed through our procurement system (we do not put software on a card for anything >$10k)
- Net terms: our standard is Net 30. For pilot purchases we can follow Net 30. If you need any extended terms we’ll need commercial sign-off.
- Invoice requirements: PDF invoice with the following fields: PO number, billing address, our tax ID, line item descriptions, and a remittance address.
- Billing address / legal name: Acme Analytics, Inc.; 120 Market St, Suite 800, San Francisco, CA 94105
- VAT / Tax: we are US-based; no VAT for this invoice, but include our Tax ID on the invoice (EIN: 12-3456789)

I’m attaching our standard PO requirements doc — Acme_PO_requirements.pdf — which summarizes contract routing, required invoice fields, and approval SLAs.

Questions for you: can Redwood accept a PO signed by our Procurement team and then issue an invoice referencing the PO (we’ll add the PO number at time of invoice)? Also — does Redwood accept PO submission via DocuSign or only by email/post?

Best,
Elena

Elena —

Thanks, this is super helpful. To confirm and provide the internal answers you asked for: 

- PO vs Card: We can accept either. For deals routed via procurement with a PO, we will issue an invoice that references the PO number you provide.
- PO submission: DocuSign is acceptable (many customers do that) or you can upload/send the signed PO to procurements@redwood.ai. Either path works for us.
- Net terms: Standard is Net 30. We can discuss extended terms if this grows into a committed Dedicated/Reserved contract (needs approval from finance).
- Invoice format: We will issue a PDF invoice with line-item detail, our tax info, and a remittance address. We can include the PO number and any required invoice fields from Acme_PO_requirements.pdf.
- Marketplace: If you prefer marketplace procurement, let us know and we’ll share the implications (billing through marketplace vendor, marketplace fees, and potentially different support/entitlement terms).

Michael and David — looping you in to confirm the technical billing/collections steps and whether any additional documents are required for the PO flow. Michael, can Redwood issue a final invoice PDF that includes a placeholder for the PO number to be filled in once Acme issues? David, please flag any contract items that might block a PO-only flow.

Elena — can you confirm the billing contact (name + email) for the invoice and whether you have a procurement system ID we should reference? Once we have that I’ll produce a final invoice/quote and send back for your PO number to be added.

Thanks —
Marissa
